scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run smoke:esafe-core && pnpm run smoke:authority-core && pnpm run smoke:work-package-core && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm run typecheck:esafe-core && pnpm run typecheck:authority-core && pnpm run typecheck:work-package-core && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
